training_index_rule.description: For training size N, use source samples with indices [0, N).

selection_rule.goal: Choose the smallest training-set size whose performance is effectively saturated.

notes: All candidate training sets are nested, so the 5000-sample training set is contained in the 10000-sample set, and so on.
Validation and test sets are identical for every training-set-size experiment.
Dataset generation seed is fixed while model-training seeds vary.
The scale study determines the final v1 dataset size; 100000 source training samples are an upper candidate, not a required final size.
